Next,
let us check
Medicare Part A
hospital coverage and
Part D prescription
drug limits for
2027.
While most people
pay zero monthly
premium for Part
A because they
worked at least
40
quarters,
the Part A
inpatient hospital deductible
rises by $40,
from $1,736
up to $1,776
per benefit period.
Over on the
prescription side,
the maximum annual
Part D deductible
rises from $615
to $700,
and your annual
out-of-pocket spending cap
for covered medications
increases from $2,100
to $2,400.
Part B and
IRMAA are changing
